verdict.rationale: The firm's own About page describes GDHQ as "a secure platform that offers easy access to your company's key corporate records," bundled with a DIY contract generator and SMART Request intake forms. Catalyze is a client-exclusive platform that gives access to "your Gunderson legal team" and a SMART Request Hub, so a secure client portal for documents and requests is documented first-party. Missing for 10: explicit matter-status or matter-tracking views, details on security controls (access management, encryption), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
